subsystems.scoring: Tilting elevator plus wrist supplies the required reach and orientation.
subsystems.drivetrain: Falcon-powered SDS MK4i modules; team switched from an initial NEO implementation after control difficulties.
subsystems.endgame: Specific charge-station mechanism/sequence is not described in the retrieved interview.
subsystems.controls: Cone/cube mode selects coordinated elevator and wrist presets; driver can hold cardinal-direction heading snaps.

versions: Initial NEO swerve configuration changed to Falcons.

limits: Some discovery lists incorrectly mix the 2024 Dial release into 2023; that source is excluded from this dossier.

context_documents.body:
# 2023-6329: Two piece modes coordinate a tilted elevator and motorized wrist

Focused study supplement. Not a full binder/CAD review, exhaustive subsystem specification, every-version history or visual interview watch.

## Published / retained construction account

An Everybot-inspired gripper changes wheel orientation and adds retaining netting for cubes. A tilted elevator and wrist acquire and place directly; software coordinates mode-specific heights, wrist angles and roller directions.

## Team-stated reasoning or boundary

The source identifies containment and shared piece handling as the gripper’s purpose. Color cues indicate the selected mode; they are not themselves a vision classification result.

## Engineering interpretation — analyst inference

A shared effector needs different states for different pieces. Confusing selected cone/cube mode with sensed possession can produce the wrong approach or release even if every motor reaches its setpoint.

## Proposed validation — not performed

Test mode disagreement, partial pickup and retention during tilt/wrist movement.

## Limits

Focused technical passages and the retained dossier are the evidence scope. Exact event installation, complete CAD tolerances and all intermediate revisions are not certified.
